about_the_game:
Hey! Go to the game's Community Center! In the discussions section you can share your opinion and send your idea for an achievement!

FASTHAND is a fast-paced, minimalist arcade shooter where your main goal is to shoot appearing balls as quickly and accurately as possible. Sounds simple? Give it a try and you'll see how addictive it can get! This game is designed for players who want to improve their reaction speed and shooting accuracy, especially for FPS/TPS games.

🎯 Game features:

  • Train your reflexes and aiming precision

  • Simple yet challenging gameplay

  • 8 language versions – play your way!

  • Clean, minimal graphics that keep you focused

  • Super affordable price – maximum value for less!

  • Fully developed by a solo indie developer – that’s me!

FASTHAND is perfect for those looking for a fun yet useful way to improve their aim. Use it as a warm-up before competitive matches, or play a quick round during your break – either way, it's a great time.

Hey there!
This is my very first game – like, ever! So… sorry in advance if anything feels a little janky, if the balls get annoying, or if the menu looks like it was made in PowerPoint 2007 😅
I really did my best, I promise!

But this is just the beginning.
I’m planning to learn, fix bugs, add updates, and make this game better over time. And in the future? Who knows – maybe something bigger, cooler, and with fewer balls (or more, if you're into that 😂).

Thanks so much for giving my little game a shot. Every “Play” click means the world to me ❤️
